brief.headline: Push for 10–15% price cut to align with market bands and fast-track two listed alternates to secure supply

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut of 10–15% on rigid plastic packaging items, especially caps and bottles
priceAsk.target: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm caps (currently asking ₹0.85–0.95 typical in market)
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows the typical ask band for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser specs — our ₹63.21 L annual spend justifies volume pricing

paymentTermAsk.summary: No change needed — keep 30 Days After Receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we cannot gauge their profit margins, cash position, or how much our ₹63.21 L spend matters to them. That means we build our ask purely on the open-market price band and on having backup suppliers lined up. Since we can't see inside their books, we lean harder on securing a qualified second source before we push too hard on price — that way we're not flying blind if they push back or stumble.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to drop to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume
HDPE resin import price stands at 87.61 ₹/kg — a public reference for raw-material cost trends
Bprex is a private company with no public financial data — we cannot confirm their revenue, margins or cash health

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already flagged in our data

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) — pails, containers, pharma packaging; strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.role: a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Pan-India resin manufacturer flagged by web research — medium confidence; would need audit and pricing before we can issue an RFQ

risks: No visibility into Bprex's finances means we cannot tell if a 10–15% cut will hurt them or if they have room — qualify Manjushree and Mold-Tek fast so we have a fallback if they refuse
Our ₹63.21 L spend may be small or large to them — without revenue data we don't know our clout, so start firm but watch for pushback that signals we're a bigger chunk than we think
Market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads only — none are qualified or priced; do not treat them as live alternates in this meeting
If Bprex digs in on price, pivot to a volume commitment or tighter specs in exchange for hitting the ₹0.65–0.80/pc band — the market verdict says that range is achievable
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about aligning your pricing with the market bands we're seeing — specifically bringing caps down toward ₹0.65–0.80 per piece at our volumes — and about how we can lock in a long-term partnership while we qualify a second source for supply security.
